startView.title: Find your games
startView.subtitle: Scan your installed launchers to import them into Steam.
startView.steamNotFound: No Steam installation found. Check the location in Settings.

sourceCard.urlOnlyTitle: This game can only be launched via its URL scheme

doneView.allDoneSubtitle: Steam shortcuts and artwork have been updated.

language.label: Language
language.description: Sets the display language for the app. Help translate on {crowdin}.

colorScheme.label: Color scheme
colorScheme.description: Choose between light, dark, or match your system.

stopSteam.label: Stop Steam before applying
stopSteam.description: Steam must be closed to modify shortcut files.

restartSteam.label: Restart Steam after applying
restartSteam.description: Relaunches Steam so imported games appear immediately.

createCollections.label: Create per-platform collections
createCollections.description: Groups imported games into a collection for each launcher.

steamLocation.label: Steam installation location
steamLocation.description: Override auto-detection if Steam isn't found automatically.

enableSteamGridDb.label: Enable SteamGridDB
enableSteamGridDb.description: Adds a button to pick custom artwork from SteamGridDB when reviewing games.

apiKey.label: SteamGridDB API key
apiKey.description: Required for SteamGridDB. Generate one for free on your account page.
apiKey.getKeyTitle: Get an API key on steamgriddb.com

allowNsfw.label: Allow NSFW artwork
allowNsfw.description: Includes NSFW-tagged images in SteamGridDB results.

export.label: Export settings
export.description: Save your current settings to a JSON file.

warning.title: Export settings?
warning.description: The exported file will contain your SteamGridDB API key in plain text. Keep it secure and avoid sharing it.

import.label: Import settings
import.description: Restore settings from a previously exported JSON file.

reset.label: Reset settings
reset.description: Restore all settings to their default values.

confirm.title: Reset settings?
confirm.description: This will restore all settings to their defaults. This cannot be undone.

backups.title: Backups
backups.restoredMessage: Restored {count} file successfully. | Restored {count} files successfully.

confirm.deleteAllBody: This will permanently delete all {count} backup. This cannot be undone. | This will permanently delete all {count} backups. This cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteBody: This will permanently delete the backup from {date}. This cannot be undone.
confirm.restoreBody: This will overwrite the current Steam files for this account with the backup from {date}. This cannot be undone.

logsFolder.label: Logs folder
logsFolder.description: Open the folder containing session log files.
